description:
The updates for this preset package are as follows:
1. Fix the issue where the default value of the travel_short_distance_acceleration,slow_down_min_speed parameter is incorrect in the process presets for certain printer models.
2. Updates the Machine Start G-code, Machine End G-code, and Filament Change G-code for P2S（Beta Firmware Version 01.01.50.40）, with the following enhancements:
  1)New support for foreign object detection beneath the heated bed before printing.
  2)New support for build plate detection, in cases where users forget to place the printing plate, intelligent detection and prompt measures are taken to prevent any other abnormalities from occurring.
3. Update the parameters for Bambu PETG Basic to ensure compatibility with the all-new Bambu Lab PETG Basic
